title: Quant+Batch Frontier: Regional Allocator and Utilization Workbook (Q1 2027)
summary: Working workbook to map the operational frontier between quantization level and batching policy across regions. Purpose: derive a compact allocator that assigns GPU types + quant profiles by region to meet target utilization (65-75%) while respecting quality SLOs and latency p50/p95 constraints. Includes a small synthetic heatmap snapshot, region-level capacity CSV, sensitivity scenarios, and rollout-safe recommendations for Q1 2027 pilot.
key_assumptions: Baseline per-GPU nominal throughput measured at seq_len=128 for A100/H100 in fp16 (see internal perf run IDs in linked artifacts)
Relative throughput multipliers: INT8 ≈ 1.3–1.5x vs fp16, INT4 ≈ 1.6–1.9x vs fp16 depending on kernel and model shape
Average request mix: 60% short (<64 tokens), 30% medium (64-256), 10% long (>256); regional mix varies (APAC heavier long-tail)
Target utilization band 65–75% to preserve latency headroom and preempt burst saturation
Quality budget: end-to-end metric (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim) degradation tolerance ≤ 1.5% for critical customers; non-critical workloads allowed up to 5%
Autoscaler reaction time budget: 90s cold-start window for capacity surge; use burst reserve pools where available
sensitivity_scenarios: Aggressive-INT4-HighBatch: shift 40% of non-critical traffic to INT4 with batch target=64; expected +35-45% throughput, median latency +8-12ms, quality risk for long-context prompts
Conservative-FP16-LowBatch: maintain fp16 for <20% quantized traffic, batch target=16; preserves quality, higher unit cost, useful for tier-1 customers
Hybrid-RegionalMix: APAC uses H100 with conservative INT8 for critical routes, EMEA uses A100 INT8 for general requests, US accepts more INT4 for background jobs
Cache-Enabled: enable prefix/KV caching for 25% of recurring requests; effective throughput gain equivalent to adding 10-15% GPU capacity in busy regions
Burst-Reserve: reserve 10% fleet as unallocated burst capacity (cold-start reuse) to handle traffic spikes with autoscaler timeout 90s
recommended_actions: Pilot plan (8 weeks): deploy region-specific quant profiles: US-east/us-west = INT8 default, non-critical background = INT4; EMEA = INT8-only for production; APAC = INT8 with manual INT4 opt-in for batch jobs
Allocator change: implement a lightweight scoring function (latency_slo, quality_risk, cost_delta) and run simulated allocation sweep; use 7-day rolling window of seq_len distribution as input
Autoscaling knobs: keep target_util 70% with upper threshold 82% to trigger burst pool; scale-down min cooldown=10m to avoid oscillation
Observability: add per-quant-profile quality regression hooks (prompt-set A/B) and p95 token latency per model+quant combo to Console dashboards
Rollback readiness: define fallback to fp16 for routes where eval set shows >1.5% quality drop on INT8 or >3% on INT4; automated canary traffic at 1% then 5% before full rollout
heatmap_snapshot: sheet tab: heatmap_v1 (rows=regions, cols=[fp16,INT8,INT4], values=estimated_tokens/s_per_cost_unit). see cell comments for perf-run ids
